WITH patient_averages AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX,
         AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_alb_minus_tp,
         AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
), sex_averages AS (
  SELECT SEX,
         AVG(avg_alb_minus_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp,
         AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
  FROM patient_averages
  GROUP BY SEX
), above_mean AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) OVER () AS mean_aptt_minus_pt
  FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT AVG(avg_alb_minus_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp,
       AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt,
       AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt - mean_aptt_minus_pt) AS excess_over_mean
FROM above_mean
WHERE avg_aptt_minus_pt > mean_aptt_minus_pt;
